title: Map WSL worktree paths before native CMake compiler probes
body: Native configure from the assigned WSL worktree failed in CMakeTestCCompiler: cmd.exe rejects the UNC working directory during vs_link_exe. A lane-local build script now pushd-maps that same worktree and invokes CMake from the mapped drive; no NTFS mirror outside the assigned checkout is used. Failed command: cmd.exe /d /c <lane>/build/upscaleinputs-native.bat configure (native-configure.log). Working route: pushd the worktree, then cmake -S %CD%/VIXEN -B %CD%/build/native-mapped -G Ninja. Consolidate mapping into build.bat/native provisioning. Tier luna: standard Windows launcher integration and a compiler-probe regression.

title: Scope Windows Git trust for native FetchContent in WSL worktrees
body: After mapping the assigned WSL worktree, native FetchContent failed cloning GLM with detected dubious ownership for the worktree-local .tmp/fetch-native/glm-src UNC path (native-configure-mapped.log). Recovered with process-local GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory, GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=<assigned-worktree-UNC>/.tmp/fetch-native/*; no global Git configuration was changed. Native provisioning should derive narrow trust for its owned dependency clones. Tier luna: launcher/environment integration and a Windows Git regression.

title: Keep Windows native configuration from invoking WSL Dozen provisioning
body: Mapped native configure inherited WSL environment detection and attempted wsl bash Z:/.../provision-wsl-vulkan.sh, failing exit 127; Windows-native rendering needs the native Vulkan loader. Recovered with the documented -DVIXEN_AUTO_PROVISION_WSL_VULKAN=OFF, after native-configure-mapped.log. Derive the provisioning domain from the CMake target/host instead of requiring this per-lane override. Tier luna: platform detection plus a native-on-WSL configuration regression.

title: Expose typed float guide readback through the graph debug capture surface
body: The temporal depth witness needed original R32F bytes, but Debug/RenderTargetReadback.h only exposed RGBA8/BGRA8-to-PNG capture and assumed four bytes per texel. This lane extracts raw readback, adds the depth/motion format byte sizes, and keeps color PNG capture as a wrapper. Derive supported formats and inspection views from resource declarations rather than each guide lane adding bespoke readback plumbing. Tier luna: shared readback API and multi-format validation.

title: Resolve mapped Windows paths before the codegen WSL bridge
body: The native configure completed despite wslpath failing on Z:/... mapped worktree paths, leaving empty codegen input/output arguments (native-configure-dependency-trust.log). This lane resolves each Windows mapped drive to its UNC share before calling wslpath, uses wsl --cd /, and fails configuration on a nonzero or empty translation. Preserve that platform input conversion in the common consumer setup, with a native mapped-drive guard witness. Tier luna: a platform path bridge and its native configure/check validation.

title: Derive graph guide hazards from reflected SDI resource access
body: ReconstructionDepth and ReconstructionExposure already declare read-only buffers and write-only images in reflected SDI. To make the real graph schedule them correctly, the lane must still pre-register BufferSyncGatherer/ImageSyncGatherer slots and manually connect BUFFER_READ_ARRAY, BUFFER_WRITE_ARRAY, and IMAGE_WRITE_ARRAY, including the exposure reducer write. Synthesize these hazard declarations from SDI member access plus provider resource identities; keep only the mathematical guide declaration authored. Tier sol: scheduler and reflection integration with cross-pass correctness tests.

title: Keep codegen launcher context out of freshness input scans
body: The native WSL bridge requires wsl --cd /, but vixen_add_codegen_check scanned every absolute command argument as a schema dependency. It recursively globbed the WSL root and two native configure jobs were watchdog-cancelled at 261s and 291s. The lane now separates the exact configured launcher prefix from tool arguments, keeps the full command in the signature, and reuses the forward path map for native dependencies. The launcher-argument unit test passes. Derive input kinds from CodegenFlag contracts when consolidating this helper. Tier luna: consumer dependency collection and an argument-contract regression.

title: Terminate Windows children when the queue cancels a native payload
body: After the queue watchdog cancelled native-configure-path-bridge and native-configure-root-cache, Windows cmake.exe children continued scanning under the assigned upscaleinputs source/build tree. Verified ProcessIds 200700 and 14048 by their complete source/build command lines, then stopped only those explicit PIDs with Stop-Process -Id 200700,14048. The queue should contain the Windows process tree in a job object and terminate it before releasing a native reservation. No pattern kill was used. Tier sol: cross-OS process lifetime and cancellation verification.

title: Avoid MSVC PCH path case folding on mapped case-sensitive WSL worktrees
body: Native Core failed C1083 on lowercased vbvs--vixen and libraries/core/cmakefiles PCH paths in native-inputs-build.log; disabling ccache reproduced it in native-core-no-cache.log. The supported -DUSE_PRECOMPILED_HEADERS=OFF option made native-no-pch-core.log pass. Native setup should derive a case-safe PCH location or select this setting automatically for WSL-mapped case-sensitive sources. Tier luna, effort M: platform-specific CMake provisioning with a native fixture.
